## Decision Filter

Per the [thesis](../blob/main/docs/thesis.md), every change must pass:

> Does this strengthen the loop that turns learning back on itself, or merely add
> information (or authority, or tooling) beside it?

- [ ] This change **strengthens the loop** (it does not merely add something beside it).
